senses.zh: 有些；几个（用于可数名词之前）

examples.en: There are a few apples on the table.
examples.zh: 桌子上有几个苹果。

notes: 名师点拨：few, a few, little, a little 的词义和用法区别，可参考考纲词汇 919. little。

examples.en: He hurt his ankle while playing football.
examples.zh: 他踢足球时伤到了脚踝。

examples.en: A balanced diet is good for our health.
examples.zh: 均衡的饮食对我们的健康有益。

examples.en: He writes a blog about his travel experiences.
examples.zh: 他写了一条关于旅行经历的博客。

notes: ＝weblog /ˈweblɒɡ/

examples.en: The calf is following its mother.
examples.zh: 小牛犊跟着它的妈妈。

examples.en: She is good at calligraphy.
examples.zh: 她擅长书法。

examples.en: We had a big celebration for his birthday.
examples.zh: 我们为他的生日举行了盛大的庆祝活动。

examples.en: His comments on the movie were very interesting.
examples.zh: 他对这部电影的评论非常有意思。

examples.en: He refused to comment on this matter.
examples.zh: 他拒绝就此事发表意见。

notes: 名师点拨：comment 作名词时，常见搭配有 make a comment“发表评论”，comment on/about“对……的评论”；作动词时，常与 on 或 upon 搭配，comment on/upon sth.“对某事发表意见”。

examples.en: They are playing tennis on the court.
examples.zh: 他们在球场上打网球。

senses.zh: （因打扰别人或失礼表示歉意）对不起；劳驾

examples.en: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the station?
examples.zh: 对不起，你能告诉我去车站的路吗？

examples.en: We found some strange footprints in the snow.
examples.zh: 我们在雪地里发现了一些奇怪的脚印。

examples.en: He bought some new fishing gear.
examples.zh: 他买了一些新的钓鱼用具。

examples.en: The goalkeeper made a great save.
examples.zh: 守门员做出了一次精彩的扑救。

examples.en: The goat is eating grass.
examples.zh: 山羊在吃草。

examples.en: Farmers grow different kinds of grains.
examples.zh: 农民种不同种类的谷物。

examples.en: The shepherd is herding the sheep.
examples.zh: 牧羊人在放羊。

examples.en: The high-speed train is very fast.
examples.zh: 高速列车非常快。

examples.en: You are late again. How come?
examples.zh: 你又迟到了。怎么回事？

examples.en: We have an ICT class today.
examples.zh: 我们今天有信息通信技术课。

notes: ＝information and communications technology

senses.zh: 我怕；恐怕；很遗憾；对不起

examples.en: I'm afraid we're late for the movie.
examples.zh: 恐怕我们看电影要迟到了。

examples.en: Flour is a main ingredient in making bread.
examples.zh: 面粉是制作面包的主要原料。

examples.en: When she heard the good news, she jumped for joy.
examples.zh: 听到这个好消息时，她欢呼雀跃。

examples.en: We usually watch TV in the living room.
examples.zh: 我们通常在客厅看电视。

notes: ＝sitting room /ˈsɪtɪŋ ruːm/

examples.en: As an only child, he gets a lot of love from his parents.
examples.zh: 作为独生子，他得到父母很多的爱。

examples.en: The chicken pecked at the seeds on the ground.
examples.zh: 那只鸡啄了地上的种子。

examples.en: She found a new recipe for making cakes.
examples.zh: 她发现了一个做蛋糕的新方子。

examples.en: The relation between the two countries is very important.
examples.zh: 两国之间的关系非常重要。

_flags: ipa：OCR 原文 /rɪ'ləʃn/，已按标准读音改为 /rɪˈleɪʃn/

examples.en: He likes rock climbing very much.
examples.zh: 他非常喜欢攀岩。

examples.en: The side dish tastes very good.
examples.zh: 这道配菜味道很好。

examples.en: Add some soy sauce to the dish.
examples.zh: 给这道菜加点酱油。

notes: ＝soya sauce /sɔɪə ˈsɔːs/

examples.en: The students are playing on the sports ground.
examples.zh: 学生们在操场上玩耍。

senses.zh: 超级激动的；格外兴奋的

examples.en: She was super-excited when she got the prize.
examples.zh: 她获奖时超级激动。

_flags: ipa：OCR 原文 /su:spə(r) ik'saɪtɪd/ 损坏，已按构词改为 /ˌsuːpə(r) ɪkˈsaɪtɪd/

examples.en: The cake is very tasty.
examples.zh: 这个蛋糕非常美味。

examples.en: The athletes are running on the track.
examples.zh: 运动员们在跑道上跑步。

notes: 常用词组：keep track of 追踪

senses.zh: （体育活动等前的）适应性活动，准备活动；热身练习

examples.en: You should warm up before doing exercise.
examples.zh: 你在做运动前应该热身。

examples.en: The sign is a warning of danger.
examples.zh: 这个标志是危险警示。

examples.en: Watch out! There is a car coming.
examples.zh: 小心！有辆车来了。

examples.en: You finished the work so quickly. Well done!
examples.zh: 你这么快就完成了工作。干得好！

examples.en: You look sad. What's the matter?
examples.zh: 你看起来很伤心。怎么了？

examples.en: The school made an announcement about the upcoming sports meeting.
examples.zh: 学校发布了一则关于即将召开的运动会的公告。

notes: 词形拓展：announce v. 宣布；宣称
常用词组：make an announcement 发布公告

examples.en: Beg your pardon, could you repeat what you just said?
examples.zh: 抱歉，你能重复一下刚才说的话吗？

examples.en: A fire broke out in the old building last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚那栋旧楼突发火灾。

notes: 名师点拨：学生需要知道 break out, happen 和 take place 在表示“发生”时的用法区别：break out 常用来描述战争、火灾、疾病等不好的事情突然发生，且没有被动语态。例如：The war broke out unexpectedly. 战争毫无征兆地发生了。happen 通常指偶然发生。例如：Sometimes, the best moments happen when you least anticipate them. 有时，最美好的瞬间会不期而遇。take place 指有计划、有安排地发生。例如：The wedding ceremony will take place at the beach at sunset. 婚礼将在日落时分在海滩上举行。

examples.en: Be careful of the broken glass on the ground.
examples.zh: 小心地上的碎玻璃。

examples.en: After the accident, he had to use a wheelchair due to a broken leg.
examples.zh: 事故发生后他断了一条腿，不得不坐轮椅。

examples.en: The bulb in the ceiling light has burned out. Could you please change it for me?
examples.zh: 吸顶灯里的灯泡坏了，你能帮我换一下吗？

examples.en: The temperature today is 25 degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 今天的温度是 25 摄氏度。

examples.en: He is a changer in our school, bringing new ideas and methods.
examples.zh: 他是我们学校的变革者，带来了新的点子和方法。

senses.zh: 察看，观察（有趣或有吸引力的人或事物）

examples.en: Check out the new art exhibition at the museum. It's really amazing.
examples.zh: 去看看博物馆的新艺术展览，真的很棒。

examples.en: This cloth feels very soft and comfortable.
examples.zh: 这种布料摸起来非常柔软舒适。

notes: 名师点拨：cloth, clothes 和 clothing 的词义和用法区别，可参考考纲词汇 310. clothes。

examples.en: Coal is still an important energy source in some regions.
examples.zh: 在某些地区，煤仍然是重要的能源来源。

senses.zh: 颜色鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的

examples.en: The children drew a very colourful picture of a rainbow.
examples.zh: 孩子们画了一幅色彩非常鲜艳的彩虹画。

examples.en: Put the water into a plastic container.
examples.zh: 把水倒入一个塑料容器里。

notes: 词形拓展：contain v. 包含；容纳

examples.en: She has long curly hair that makes her look very cute.
examples.zh: 她有一头长长的卷发，使她看起来非常可爱。

notes: 反义：straight

examples.en: My new neighbour is very easy-going and we get along well.
examples.zh: 我的新邻居非常随和，我们相处得很好。

examples.en: We should take some environmental protection measures to save our planet.
examples.zh: 我们应该采取一些环境保护措施来拯救我们的星球。

notes: 常用词组：environmental protection 环境保护；environmental problem 环境问题
_flags: ipa：OCR 原文 /m,veirən'mentl/ 损坏，已按标准读音改为 /ɪnˌvɪərənˈmentl/

examples.en: Take the escalator to the second floor, and you can find the clothing store.
examples.zh: 乘自动扶梯到二楼，你就能找到服装店。

examples.en: The news of the school trip excited all the students.
examples.zh: 学校旅行的消息让所有学生都很兴奋。

examples.en: We are facing extreme weather conditions, such as heavy snow and strong winds.
examples.zh: 我们正面临极端的天气状况，比如大雪和强风。

notes: 词形拓展：extremely adv. 极其；非常
常用词组：extreme heat 酷热；extreme cold 严寒

examples.en: It was a foggy morning, and the visibility was very low.
examples.zh: 那是一个雾蒙蒙的早晨，能见度很低。

examples.en: There is a small gap between the two boards.
examples.zh: 两块木板之间有个小缝隙。

notes: 常用词组：generation gap 代沟；the gap between ... and ... ……和……之间的差距/间隙

examples.en: The farmers are very happy with the good harvest this year.
examples.zh: 农民们因今年的好收成特别高兴。

notes: 常用词组：harvest time 收获时节；busy with the harvest 忙于收获

examples.en: The city was hit by a severe heatwave last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天，这座城市遭受了严重的热浪袭击。

examples.en: Many herbs are used in cooking to add flavour.
examples.zh: 许多香草被用于烹饪以增添风味。

examples.en: Hurrah! We won the first prize in the competition!
examples.zh: 万岁！我们在比赛中获得了一等奖！

notes: 名师点拨：hurrah 是感叹词，用于表达欢呼、喜悦、庆祝等强烈的积极情绪。类似的表达还有 hurray, yay 等，通常用于口语和非正式写作中，书写时常用感叹号加强语气。
_flags: ipa：OCR 原文 /'hɜ:rə/ 存疑，已按标准读音改为 /həˈrɑː/

examples.en: It's too cold outside, so we stay indoors and watch TV.
examples.zh: 外面太冷了，所以我们待在室内看电视。

notes: 反义：outdoors

examples.en: You can buy some inexpensive souvenirs at this local market.
examples.zh: 你可以在这个当地市场买到一些便宜的纪念品。

_flags: ipa：OCR 原文 /,ɪn'kspensiv/ 缺音节，已按标准读音改为 /ˌɪnkənˈspensɪv/

examples.en: She leaned on/against her friend's shoulder when she felt sad.
examples.zh: 她难过的时候靠在朋友的肩膀上。

examples.en: The old house leant to one side.
examples.zh: 这座老房子向一侧倾斜。

notes: 变形：leant /lent/, leant 或 leaned /liːnd/, leaned

examples.en: We should use more low-energy appliances to save resources.
examples.zh: 我们应该使用更多低能耗的电器来节约资源。

examples.en: According to the lunar calendar, the Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China.
examples.zh: 根据农历，春节是中国最重要的传统节日。

examples.en: Mankind has made remarkable progress in science and technology.
examples.zh: 人类在科学技术方面取得了显著的进步。

_flags: ipa：OCR 原文 /ˈmænˌkænd/ 有误，已按标准读音改为 /mænˈkaɪnd/

examples.en: I usually go to bed before midnight to keep a good schedule.
examples.zh: 我通常在午夜前上床睡觉，以保持良好作息。

notes: 常用词组：at midnight 在午夜

examples.en: The company made a profit of three million dollars last year.
examples.zh: 这家公司去年盈利300万美元。

notes: 常用词组：millions of 数以百万计的；很多

名师点拨：million 前有具体数字时，无论数字是几，million 都用单数形式；表示数量极多但不确切的情况时，用 millions of，后接可数名词复数，类似的表达还有 thousands of“数以千计的”、hundreds of“数以百计的”。例如：The population of the city is over five million people. 那座城市的人口超过500万。There are millions of stars in the sky. 天空中有数以百万计的星星。

examples.en: Millions of people travel abroad every year.
examples.zh: 每年有数百万人出国旅行。

examples.en: The students in this class are mostly from the local area.
examples.zh: 这个班的学生大多来自当地。

examples.en: She has a great musical talent and can play several instruments.
examples.zh: 她有很棒的音乐天赋，会演奏好几种乐器。

examples.en: We watched a wonderful musical in the theatre last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我们在剧院看了一场精彩的音乐剧。

notes: 常用词组：musical instrument 乐器；musical performance 音乐表演

examples.en: The nightingale's song is very beautiful and can be heard in the forest at night.
examples.zh: 夜莺的歌声非常美妙，晚上在森林里能听到。

examples.en: Check the noticeboard regularly, as there are always some important announcements.
examples.zh: 定期查看布告栏，因为总是有一些重要通知。

examples.en: Nuts are a good source of protein and healthy fats.
examples.zh: 坚果是蛋白质和健康脂肪的良好来源。

notes: 常用词组：a hard nut to crack 棘手的问题；难对付的人

senses.zh: 传递；转交；（用后）递给，传给

examples.en: Please pass on this message to your parents when you get home.
examples.zh: 你到家时请把这个消息转告给你的父母。

examples.en: After reading the book, pass it on to a friend.
examples.zh: 读完这本书后，把它传给一位朋友。

examples.en: The mother patted her baby gently on the back to make him stop crying.
examples.zh: 妈妈轻轻地拍着宝宝的背，让他停止哭泣。

examples.en: The peacock spread its colourful tail feathers to show off its beauty.
examples.zh: 孔雀展开它色彩斑斓的尾羽来炫耀自己的美丽。

examples.en: Penicillin has saved countless lives since it was discovered.
examples.zh: 青霉素自被发现以来，拯救了无数生命。

_flags: ipa：OCR 原文 /'penislin/ 重音有误，已按标准读音改为 /ˌpenɪˈsɪlɪn/

examples.en: Everyone has a unique personality, which makes them different from others.
examples.zh: 每个人都有独特的个性，这使他们与众不同。

examples.en: The power station provides electricity for the whole city.
examples.zh: 这座发电站为整个城市供电。

examples.en: Please give my regards to your parents when you see them.
examples.zh: 见到你父母时，请代我向他们问好。

notes: 常用词组：with kind regards（常用于信件结尾）致以亲切的问候

examples.en: Jerry's family has made the fifth day of each month their reunion day.
examples.zh: 杰瑞一家把每月的5号定为家庭团聚日。

notes: 词形拓展：reunite v.（使）重逢；（使）团聚
_flags: ipa：OCR 原文 /ri: 'junin/ 缺音节，已按标准读音改为 /riːˈjuːniən/

senses.zh: 可重复使用的；可再次使用的

examples.en: We should use more reusable bags instead of plastic bags to protect the environment.
examples.zh: 我们应该多用可重复使用的袋子，而不是塑料袋，以保护环境。

examples.en: The plane landed safely on the runway after a long flight.
examples.zh: 经过长时间的飞行，飞机安全降落在跑道上。

examples.en: The firefighters are the savers in the fire, rescuing people from danger.
examples.zh: 消防员在火灾中是救助者，把人们从危险中解救出来。

examples.en: You should sort your clothes by colour before putting them in the wardrobe.
examples.zh: 你应该先把衣服按颜色分类，再放进衣柜。

examples.en: What sort of music do you like best?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢那种音乐？

notes: 常用词组：sort out 整理；解决；sort sth. into ... 把某物分类为……；sort sth. by ... 根据……对某物进行分类；all sorts of 各种各样的；a sort of 一种

examples.en: Spring rolls are a popular snack during the Chinese New Year.
examples.zh: 春卷是春节期间很受欢迎的小吃。

examples.en: The storyteller can always attract a lot of children with his interesting stories.
examples.zh: 这个讲故事的人总能用他有趣的故事吸引很多孩子。

examples.en: We sat in the garden, enjoying the warm sunshine.
examples.zh: 我们坐在花园里，享受着温暖的阳光。

_flags: ipa：OCR 原文 /'sAnfəm/ 损坏，已按标准读音改为 /ˈsʌnʃaɪn/

examples.en: "You swan, he frog" has become a popular internet catchphrase.
examples.zh: “癞蛤蟆（青蛙）想吃天鹅肉”成为了一条网络热梗。

examples.en: The symphony performed by the famous orchestra was really amazing.
examples.zh: 著名管弦乐队演奏的这首交响乐真是太棒了。

notes: 词形拓展：symphonic adj. 交响乐的；和声的

examples.en: We take turns to clean the classroom.
examples.zh: 我们轮流打扫教室。
examples.rewrite: We clean the classroom in turn.

examples.en: Einstein's theory of relativity is one of the most important scientific theories in history.
examples.zh: 爱因斯坦的相对论是历史上最重要的科学理论之一。

notes: 词形拓展：theoretical adj. 理论的；理论上的

examples.en: Traditional Chinese Medicine has a long history and unique treatment methods.
examples.zh: 中医药有着悠久的历史和独特的治疗方法。

examples.en: Hamlet is one of Shakespeare's most famous tragedies.
examples.zh: 《哈姆雷特》是莎士比亚最著名的悲剧之一。

notes: 词形拓展：tragic adj. 悲剧的；悲惨的

examples.en: The old town tells lively stories about Shanghai's past and its unique culture.
examples.zh: 这座古镇讲述着关于上海的过往和独特文化的生动故事。

examples.en: My alarm clock goes off at 6:00 every morning.
examples.zh: 我的闹钟每天早上6点响。

examples.en: She has a very artistic taste.
examples.zh: 她很有艺术品味。

examples.en: The Great Wall is a major tourist attraction in China.
examples.zh: 长城是中国主要的旅游胜地。

examples.en: His belief in hard work led to his success.
examples.zh: 他对努力工作的信念使他获得了成功。

examples.en: She has a successful career in business.
examples.zh: 她在商业领域有成功的事业。

examples.en: The football fans chanted their team's name.
examples.zh: 球迷们反复呼喊着他们球队的名字。

examples.en: Good communication is very important in a relationship.
examples.zh: 良好的沟通在人际关系中非常重要。

examples.en: The actors wore beautiful costumes in the play.
examples.zh: 演员们在剧中穿着漂亮的演出服。

examples.en: Modern technology has rescued countless lives in the medical field.
examples.zh: 现代科技在医疗领域拯救了无数生命。

examples.en: She is a well-known fashion designer.
examples.zh: 她是一位著名的时装设计师。

examples.en: My deskmate is very helpful.
examples.zh: 我的同桌很乐于助人。

examples.en: This is a new device for measuring temperature.
examples.zh: 这是一种测量温度的新仪器。

examples.en: To my disappointment, I didn't pass the exam.
examples.zh: 令我失望的是，我没有通过考试。

examples.en: Honesty is an important element in a friendship.
examples.zh: 诚实是友谊中的一个重要要素。

examples.en: I decided to enter for the singing competition.
examples.zh: 我决定报名参加歌唱比赛。

notes: 名师点拨：enter for, attend, join, join in 和 take part in 的用法区别，可参考考纲词汇 843. join。

examples.en: The clown entertained the children with funny tricks.
examples.zh: 小丑用有趣的把戏逗孩子们开心。

_flags: ipa：OCR 原文 /ɪnˈteɪtən/ 有误，已按标准读音改为 /ˌentəˈteɪn/

examples.en: He held the rope firmly.
examples.zh: 他紧紧地抓住绳子。

notes: 词形拓展：firm adj. 坚定的；坚决的

examples.en: The river flows through the city.
examples.zh: 这条河流经这座城市。

examples.en: The fireflies glow in the dark.
examples.zh: 萤火虫在黑暗中发光。

examples.en: The teacher's guidance helped me a lot.
examples.zh: 老师的指导对我帮助很大。

examples.en: I have an appointment with my hairdresser tomorrow for a haircut.
examples.zh: 我明天约了理发师剪头发。

examples.en: The handle of the cup is broken.
examples.zh: 杯子的把手断了。

examples.en: We have a lot in common, such as our hobbies.
examples.zh: 我们有很多共同之处，比如我们的爱好。

examples.en: The government is trying to improve the health care system.
examples.zh: 政府正在努力改善医疗服务体系。

examples.en: The heating in our house doesn't work well.
examples.zh: 我们家的暖气设备不太好。

examples.en: This is a pen holder.

examples.en: Teenagers like to hang out with their friends in the mall.
examples.zh: 青少年喜欢和朋友在商场闲逛。

notes: 名师点拨：hang out 是口语化的短语，后接地点时需加介词 in/at。例如：We often hang out at the coffee shop near the school. 我们经常去学校附近的咖啡店。

examples.en: We should live in harmony with all living things on the earth.
examples.zh: 我们应该和地球上的所有生物和谐共处。

notes: 常用词组：in harmony with 与……和谐相处
近义词：peace; unity
反义词：discord; conflict

examples.en: This advertisement helps to build a good image of the brand.
examples.zh: 这则广告有助于树立该品牌的良好形象。

notes: 常用词组：public image 公众形象；image processing 图像处理

examples.en: Take an umbrella with you in case it rains this afternoon.
examples.zh: 带把伞吧，以防今天下午下雨。

notes: 名师点拨：in case 后接从句；in case of 后接名词。例如：We should keep some food in case of an emergency. 我们应该存些食物以防紧急情况。

examples.en: In short, we need to take action to protect the environment right now.
examples.zh: 总之，我们现在就应该采取行动保护环境。

notes: 近义词：in a word; to sum up

examples.en: She is a popular social media influencer with millions of fans.
examples.zh: 她是一位拥有数百万粉丝的网红博主。

examples.en: The man injured his brain and couldn't remember anything for a long time.
examples.zh: 这名男子脑部受伤，很长一段时间里什么都记不起来了。

notes: 词形拓展：injured adj. 受伤的；injury n. 伤害；损伤
近义：hurt; harm

examples.en: The nurse in the rescue team treated the injured boy with great patience and care.
examples.zh: 救援队的护士以极大的耐心与关怀照料着受伤的男孩。

notes: 常用词组：the injured 伤员（复数概念）

examples.en: He suffered a serious injury in the sports meeting.
examples.zh: 他在运动会中受了重伤。

examples.en: Her mother gave her a piece of jewellery on her birthday.
examples.zh: 她妈妈在她生日时送了她一件珠宝。

notes: 《美》jewelery
词形拓展：jewel n. 宝石；珠宝首饰；jeweller n. 珠宝商
常用词组：wear jewellery 佩戴首饰

examples.en: Learning to swim is a life-saving skill.
examples.zh: 学会游泳是一项救生技能。

notes: 常用词组：life-saving equipment 救生设备；life-saving operation 救命手术

examples.en: Colorful lights lit up the whole street at night.
examples.zh: 五颜六色的灯在晚上点亮了整条街道。

notes: 名师点拨：light up 还可表示“（脸）露出喜色”。例如：Her face lit up when she saw the birthday cake. 当她看到生日蛋糕时，脸上露出了喜色。

examples.en: The low-lying areas are easy to be flooded when it rains heavily.
examples.zh: 暴雨时低洼地区容易被淹。

examples.en: The little girl had a magical experience in the fairy tale park.
examples.zh: 小女孩在童话公园有了一次神奇的经历。

notes: 近义：wonderful

senses.zh: 出错；搞砸；（在某事上）处理不当

examples.en: He messed up the important meeting because of his carelessness.
examples.zh: 他因为粗心搞砸了这次重要的会议。

notes: 近义：ruin; spoil

examples.en: She bought a new sports outfit for the PE class this term.
examples.zh: 她为这学期的体育课买了一套新的运动服。

examples.en: She was over the moon when she heard she passed the exam.
examples.zh: 听到自己通过了考试，她欣喜若狂。

notes: 近义：on cloud nine; extremely happy

examples.en: You can make the payment online or in cash in this shop.
examples.zh: 你可以在这家店在线支付或者用现金付款。

notes: 常用词组：online payment 在线支付；payment method 支付方式

examples.en: We spent a peaceful weekend in the small village in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我们在山里的小村庄度过了一个宁静的周末。

notes: 近义：calm; quiet
反义：noisy

examples.en: What percentage of the students in your class walk to school?
examples.zh: 你们班有百分之多少的学生步行上学？

notes: 名师点拨：percentage 后接“of + 名词”，谓语动词的单复数由主语中的名词决定。例如：A large percentage of the water is polluted. 很大一部分的水被污染了。

examples.en: We use a pie chart to show the percentage of different fruits we bought.
examples.zh: 我们用饼形图展示所购买的不同水果的占比。

examples.en: I save my pocket money to buy a new storybook every month.
examples.zh: 我每个月都存零花钱买一本新的故事书。

examples.en: She learned pottery from a famous artist last year.
examples.zh: 她去年向一位著名的艺术家学习了制陶技艺。

examples.en: The city is developing rapidly in recent years.
examples.zh: 这座城市近年来发展得很迅速。

notes: 近义：quickly; fast
反义：slowly; gradually

examples.en: He chose to stay at home rather than go out with his friends.
examples.zh: 他选择待在家里，而不是和朋友出去。

notes: 名师点拨：rather than 连接两个并列成分，后接动词常用原形。例如：I prefer to read books rather than watch TV after dinner. 晚饭后我更喜欢看书，而不是看电视。

examples.en: My home is on Park Rd. near the central supermarket.
examples.zh: 我家在公园路上，靠近中心超市。

notes: ＝road

examples.en: She felt relaxed after listening to the soft music for a while.
examples.zh: 听了一会儿轻音乐后，她感觉很放松。

notes: 近义：calm; at ease
反义：nervous; tense

examples.en: The rescue of the lost hiker took three days in the mountain.
examples.zh: 在山里营救迷路的徒步旅行者花了3天时间。

examples.en: The firefighters rushed to rescue the people in the burning building.
examples.zh: 消防员赶赴现场营救着火大楼里的人。

notes: 词形拓展：rescuer n. 营救者；救援人员
常用词组：rescue team 救援队；come to one's rescue 前来营救某人

examples.en: The company gave away free samples of the new drink to customers.
examples.zh: 这家公司向顾客赠送了新饮料的免费样品。

examples.en: The little boy is scared of the dark when he is alone at home.
examples.zh: 小男孩独自在家时怕黑。

notes: 近义：afraid; frightened
反义：brave; fearless
名师点拨：scared 后常接介词 of，构成 be scared of (doing) sth.。例如：She is scared of speaking in front of many people. 她害怕在很多人面前讲话。

examples.en: The famous sculptor made a statue of a little girl in the park.
examples.zh: 这位著名的雕塑家在公园里雕刻了一座小女孩的雕像。

notes: 词形拓展：sculpt v. 雕刻；雕塑；sculpture n. 雕塑；雕塑作品

examples.en: There is a beautiful stone sculpture in the centre of the square.
examples.zh: 广场中央有一座精美的石雕。

examples.en: Painting is a good way of self-expression for many artists.
examples.zh: 绘画对很多艺术家来说是一种很好的自我表达方式。

examples.en: He stared out of the window.
examples.zh: 他凝视着窗外。

examples.en: It's impolite to stare at strangers in the street.
examples.zh: 在街上盯着陌生人看是不礼貌的。

notes: 近义：gaze at

examples.en: He felt terribly sorry for his mistake in the project.
examples.zh: 他为自己在项目中犯的错误感到非常抱歉。

notes: 近义：badly; extremely

examples.en: To my surprise, he passed the difficult exam with full marks.
examples.zh: 令我惊讶的是，他以满分通过了这次很难的考试。

examples.en: I totally agree with your opinion about this important matter.
examples.zh: 我完全同意你对这件重要事情的看法。

notes: 近义：completely; entirely

examples.en: He wears a pair of white trainers to school every day.
examples.zh: 他每天穿一双白色运动鞋上学。

senses.zh: （金属、塑料、橡皮制成的）管，管子

examples.en: The water flows through a plastic tube to the garden in the backyard.
examples.zh: 水通过一根塑料管流到后院的花园里。

notes: 常用词组：a tube of toothpaste 一管牙膏

examples.en: A strong typhoon will hit the coastal city next week.
examples.zh: 一场强台风将在下周袭击这座沿海城市。

examples.en: The teacher urged us to finish our homework on time every day.
examples.zh: 老师敦促我们每天按时完成作业。

notes: 常用词组：urge sb. to do sth. 敦促某人做某事；urge sb. into doing sth. 力劝某人做某事

senses.zh: 很有用的；很重要的；宝贵的

examples.en: We gained a lot of valuable experience from this interesting competition.
examples.zh: 我们从这个有趣的比赛中获得了很多宝贵的经验。

notes: 近义：precious; important
反义：worthless; useless

examples.en: The writer described the beautiful scene with vivid language in the novel.
examples.zh: 作者在小说中用生动的语言描绘了这处美景。

notes: 近义：lively

examples.en: Whoever comes to the party will get a small and lovely gift.
examples.zh: 无论谁来参加派对，都会得到一份小巧可爱的礼物。

notes: 名师点拨：whoever 可引导让步状语从句（= no matter who），也可引导名词性从句。例如：Whoever you ask, no one will reveal the secret. 无论你问谁，都不会有人泄露这个秘密。Whoever breaks the rule will be punished. 无论谁违反规则都会受到惩罚。
